reviews.title: Good to go
reviews.body: Very good product. As a firearm instructor I use this stapled and the staples that come with it to a fix paper targets onto the cardboard backers. Works well. There are the occassional hick-ups where it jamps but it is easy to fix.I have also used it to staple other materials like canvas and netting to wooden beams.

reviews.title: Great Price
reviews.body: Old school heavy duty stapler that works and will probably outlast all others. But it takes a lot of muscle to operate...hense the reason I bought the Ryobi 18v battery stapler it takes 5 different size staples and takes no muscle at all to operate all day and night. For you ladies look for it at HD on sale dates like Ryobi days.

reviews.author: Terry

reviews.title: Had to disassemble and clean
reviews.body: Arrow is a good product but when I loaded this the staples barely slid in, I had to force it. But it wouldn't fire any staples. So I removed the screw pin and took the staple tray out, it looked like rust or some type of dried liquid was on the inside. I cleaned it out. It fires now but we'll see what happens in everyday use.  It looks like the tray wasn't new or it came from the factory defective.  The rest of the steel body was flawless.

reviews.title: Total POS! Do not buy this!
reviews.body: Do not buy this POS stapler!  Extremely sloppy mechanization causes just about every other staple to jam.  You'll spend more time pulling out jamed staples with pliers than you will putting good ones in.  Regardless of how much pressure you apply to the top front directly over the shut it will jam.  No excuse for such shoddy product quality.  Return window has passed by a couple of days as I was on vacation, so this POS is going in the trash.  No way would I give it to someone else knowing the frustration it would cause.  I definitely do not recommend this product and would be very suspect of any other ones this company makes.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on April 13, 2026
reviews.author: Jimi

features: SAVE TIME AND ENERGY: This stapler is great for professional or household projects like installing insulation, upholstery, wood, general repairs, and crafts; it belongs in the workshop of any builder, maker, or crafter
COMFORT AND CONSISTENCY: The high leverage handle on this stapler provides a comfortable experience and helps ensure that each strike drives the staples though the materials you are fastening
EFFICIENCY AND VISIBILITY: The rear-load magazine with jam-resistant mechanism provides a smooth stapling experience; the staple-viewing window takes the guesswork out of knowing when to reload
HEAVY DUTY CONSTRUCTION: Featuring a chromed-steel body, this tool has the strength for any job; the steel parts have been hardened in a 1,500-degree furnace for maximum durability

STAPLE GUN STAPLES: This tool works best with Arrow T50 Staples in 1/4-Inch, 5/16-Inch, 3/8-Inch, 1/2-Inch, or 9/16-Inch (sold separately); T50 staples are used for heavy-duty applications – from crafting and general home repairs to upholstering chairs and window treatments
